summary: DoubleLine Opportunistic Credit Fund filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $75,210,876 of common shares, par value $0.00001, under a distribution agreement dated October 2, 2026 with Foreside Fund Services as distributor and UBS Securities as sub-placement agent. Sales occur from time to time at market prices, so no fixed price, premium or discount applies; unsold shares from a prior N-2 registration are carried forward under Rules 415(a)(6) and 457(p). No board recommendation, advisor opinion, closing date or break fee is stated. Watch dilution, NAV discount dynamics and leverage at 6.53% of managed assets.
